verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes show the public reading surface is gated by a bot wall. www.nvsos.gov returned an Akamai 403 'Access Denied' to a standard identified UA, and a follow-up the same day got an Imperva Incapsula bot-challenge interstitial. The ORION portal (esos.nv.gov to orion.nv.gov) also served an Incapsula shell, so the guidance pages are not reachable by a keyless agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
